**PotentialHeat 1.5.1**

- **Lighter on the CPU, same sound.** The 2x oversampling filters now use the filter's symmetry (each pair of mirrored taps shares one multiply) and read their history in one straight run. In a 60-second test over every CHARACTER and drive it did about 31% less work, with 99.8% of output samples identical and the rest within the smallest possible step (1 bit of 16).
